# HexPiece 3.7.3

The Phoenix's last two moves, in both forms, built on the reference GIFs. The Phoenix now has its full kit. **Not tested in game
yet:** the build and all 13 test suites pass, and every move was rendered in previews.

## V: Phoenix Inferno
- **Human:** phoenix wings and a gold tail of fire burst out of your back. Side on, you rain twelve burning kicks on whoever is in
  front of you. Your leg is a blur of blue fire with white arcs of air off each kick, and they are held where they stand. The last
  kick goes up and throws them high. You backflip away and land in a burst of blue flame and gold embers that scatters the wings.
  Damage: 0.5 a kick, 15 for the last one.
- **Phoenix:** the phoenix spins in place, wings spread and faster and faster, inside a whirlpool of cyan and white fire. Bands of
  flame swirl round it with tongues racing round and up. Everyone inside is burnt every few ticks and pulled toward the middle.
  It then flies straight up about 9 blocks, throwing everyone inside up with it. It dives back down onto the middle of the
  whirlpool in a huge blast of blue, white and gold fire that throws blocks of the ground up, leaving a burning crater. Damage: 0.4
  every 3 ticks in the whirlpool, 15 when it rises, 15 for the blast.

## B: Bluebird (hold B)
- **Human:** phoenix wings spread at your back, and a ball of yellow and blue fire grows between your cupped hands. It has a
  white-hot heart, tongues of flame, crackling rays and swirling gold arcs, and gets bigger the longer you hold (up to 3 seconds).
  Let go and you thrust it forward. It flies until it hits someone or something, then blows up, with a bigger blast the longer you
  held. Damage: 9.
- **Phoenix:** the phoenix holds its wings spread while flames gather round it into a white orb at its chest. Let go and it fires
  four balls of blue and gold fire one after another, slightly apart (left, right, high, low). Each blows up on what it meets.
  Damage: 9 each.

With the Conqueror's Haki and Ryou on, every blow throws the Conqueror's lightning, and every explosion throws it outward from the
blast.
